title: The Inner Compass
short: Thirty days to reflect with intention and turn what you notice into a next step.
subtitle: Know what you feel. Choose what comes next.
intro: A 30-day guided reflection journal in development for understanding emotions, reconnecting with values and choosing a thoughtful next step. The planned progression gives difficult days and meaningful changes somewhere to land.
features: Planned daily check-in for feelings, context and what you need
Planned prompts exploring recurring patterns, values and boundaries
Planned exercises separating an observation from the story around it
Planned weekly reviews that turn reflection into one small action
Planned printable writing pages with room for honest, unhurried answers
inside: Notice without rushing
Name the feeling, the moment around it and what deserves your attention.
Find the pattern
Explore the needs, values and boundaries underneath recurring experiences.
Choose with intention
Turn what you learn into a grounded next step and a weekly review.
note: The journal is in development. It supports self-reflection and is not therapy or a crisis service. Interior pages are not yet available.

title: The Financial Clarity Kit
short: A clearer view of your income, spending and the goals you are working toward.
subtitle: Make your money support your life.
intro: An editable toolkit in development for understanding your month, noticing spending patterns and choosing realistic savings priorities. The aim is a clearer relationship with everyday money, with practical organization rather than investment advice.
features: Planned monthly overview of income, commitments and money remaining
Planned planned-versus-actual expense categories and spending review
Planned subscription audit with renewal dates and cancellation reminders
Planned savings goals connected to a realistic monthly contribution
Planned month-end reflection: what changed, what worked and what to adjust
inside: Understand the month
A planned overview of income, expenses and what remains.
Notice the patterns
Planned category summaries and subscription reviews.
Choose the next step
Planned savings targets that connect to your budget.
note: This workbook has not been released. Features and Excel / Google Sheets compatibility require completion and testing.

title: The Next Chapter
short: Get clear on what matters, choose a direction and build your next 90 days around it.
subtitle: Your life is allowed to change direction.
intro: A life-planning toolkit in development for the in-between moments: a fresh start, a change of priorities or the feeling that something needs to shift. Start with where you are, define what matters and test your next direction in manageable steps.
features: Planned life-area review: energy, time, relationships, work and wellbeing
Planned values and priorities exercises to clarify what to protect or change
Planned decision pages for comparing options and naming trade-offs
Planned 90-day focus with milestones and weekly next actions
Planned stop/start/continue reviews and a reset when circumstances change
inside: Take stock
Notice what gives you energy, what drains it and what no longer fits.
Choose a direction
Define one meaningful focus and the trade-offs you are willing to make.
Build the next 90 days
Turn that direction into small experiments, milestones and weekly reviews.
note: This planner is in development. The complete 90-day workbook is not yet available.

title: Steady Strength
short: Build a training rhythm you can return to. Track effort, recovery and the habits behind progress.
subtitle: Consistency has a quieter kind of strength.
intro: A training-and-habit tracker in development for people who want a routine that lasts beyond a motivated Monday. Organize the sessions you already choose, notice recovery and build a useful picture of your consistency over 12 weeks.
features: Planned weekly training schedule with space for your own activities
Planned session logs for movement, duration, effort and notes
Planned habit tracking for the routines that support consistency
Planned recovery check-ins for sleep, energy and how a session felt
Planned weekly reviews and a practical return-after-a-break page
inside: Set a rhythm
Choose a manageable schedule around your existing training and real commitments.
Track the process
Record sessions, effort and recovery without reducing progress to a single number.
Adjust and return
Review what is sustainable and use a missed week as information for the next one.
note: This tracker is in development. It organizes your chosen activities; it does not prescribe exercise, nutrition or medical treatment.

title: The Weekly Reset Planner
short: A fresh page for your priorities, your habits and a week with more breathing room.
subtitle: A fresh start, any day of the week.
intro: Bring the week into focus with two thoughtfully arranged printable pages. Choose what matters, keep appointments visible and make time to notice what is working.
features: Weekly priorities, important tasks and appointments
Personal goal and next small step
A seven-day habit tracker with four habit rows
Weekly reflection and preparation for the next week
US Letter pages, with fit-to-page printing for A4
inside: Choose
Set three priorities and one simple intention.
Make room
Plan appointments, important tasks and a personal goal.
Reset
Review what worked and choose one adjustment for next week.
note: Free to download. No account or email address required.
